body:
Can't blame me for not knowing the point of this PR as your description didn't mention it nor linked to a proposal.

I gave this PR a try and I think this feature requires a different paradigm. Pinning is used throughout the engine as a means to keep a panel open, and my first thought (without reading the tooltip of the button) was that this property would somehow stay visible in the inspector even when navigating to another object. Which it doesn't do, obviously.

Some suggestions:
- Call it "Force Save" paired with an icon such as a fist or three small arrows pointing sideways (eg strong forces), idea being that this property is saved regardless of whether it's the instance's default or not.
- Call it "Shield Property" paired with a small shield, idea being that you can shield the property from being overwritten by changes from the instance.
